evidenceCases.assertion: A stable source snapshot produces one deterministic semantic tree with explicit hierarchy, headings, tables, decoration, and evidence links.
A publication binding records exact snapshot, manifest, locale, renderer profile, brand revision, output digest, and assessor scope.
Customer-safe and internal-only projections retain explicit sensitivity; missing alternate text remains NOT_PROVIDED and source-private bytes are omitted.
Cycles, orphans, duplicate identities, invalid order/headings/tables, privacy violations, forged claims, stale assessments, and unsupported conformance fail closed.
Tree/render/assessment interruptions leave zero or one canonical state, are retryable, and cannot duplicate or partially commit the receipt.
Recovery rebuilds only the derived tree, preserves immutable assessment history, and appends a successor for a valid correction or re-assessment.
The sealed hydration fence is exactly 119 paths: 105 existing and 14 new, with zero S10 overlap and 1216 authorized prior-fence edges.
Activation, native, hosted, adoption, acceptance, release, provider, network, account, cloud, and Phase 10 flags remain false pending accepted S10.6 reconciliation.
